description_en: Queries cloud browser groups and their current status by paging
description_zh: 分页查询云浏览器组及其当前状态
name: ListBrowserInstanceGroup

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number, starting from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 查询页码，从第 1 页开始
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
Filters by browser group status.

Limit: Only one status value can be specified at a time
parameters.help_zh:
按浏览器组状态筛选。

限制： 一次只能传入一个状态
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The cloud browser group ID for exact match queries
parameters.help_zh: 云浏览器组标识，用于精确查询
parameters.name: browser_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en: The browser group set ID for exact match queries of active members in the set
parameters.help_zh: 浏览器组集合标识，用于精确查询该集合的有效成员
parameters.name: app_instance_group_set_id

parameters.help_en: Performs a contains match by browser group name or ID
parameters.help_zh: 按浏览器组名称或标识进行包含匹配
parameters.name: cloud_browser_name

parameters.help_en: Filters browser groups by business region
parameters.help_zh: 按业务地域筛选浏览器组
parameters.name: biz_region_id

fields.help_en: The tag key. Do not specify this parameter in customer-facing scenarios
fields.help_zh: 标签键。当前对客场景不填写
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. Do not specify this parameter in customer-facing scenarios
fields.help_zh: 标签值。当前对客场景不填写
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tag filter parameters. This parameter is not supported in customer-facing scenarios. Do not specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 标签筛选参数。当前对客场景暂不支持，请勿填写
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The browser group name. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 浏览器组名称，支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: browser_instance_group_name

parameters.help_en: Filters by authorized user group IDs
parameters.help_zh: 按已授权的用户组标识筛选
parameters.name: user_group_ids

parameters.help_en: Excludes browser groups that are authorized to the specified user groups
parameters.help_zh: 排除已授权给指定用户组的浏览器组
parameters.name: excluded_user_group_ids

parameters.help_en: Filters browser groups by office network ID
parameters.help_zh: 按所属办公网络标识筛选浏览器组
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en:
Filters by version of the browser.

`Basic`: Basic Edition.
`Pro`: Premium Edition.

Use `Pro` to query MAU browser groups
parameters.help_zh:
按浏览器版本筛选。

`Basic`：基础版。
`Pro`：高级版。

查询 MAU 浏览器组时使用 `Pro`
parameters.name: tier

BrowserInstanceGroupModels.description_en: The list of browser groups on the current page
BrowserInstanceGroupModels.description_zh: 当前页的浏览器组列表

AuthNotificationEnabled.description_en: Indicates whether authorization and deauthorization notification emails are enabled. `true` indicates enabled. `false` indicates disabled
AuthNotificationEnabled.description_zh: 是否启用授权及解除授权通知邮件。`true` 表示启用，`false` 表示关闭
AuthNotificationEnabled.title_en: 是否启用授权及解除授权通知邮件
AuthNotificationEnabled.title_zh: 是否启用授权及解除授权通知邮件

AuthorizedUserInfo.description_en: The authorized user statistics of the browser group
AuthorizedUserInfo.description_zh: 浏览器组的授权用户统计

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of authorized users

TotalUserGroupCount.description_en: The total number of authorized user groups

BizRegionId.description_en: The business region where the browser group is located
BizRegionId.description_zh: 浏览器组所在的业务地域

BrowserParam.description_en: The browser startup parameters. For example, `--incognito` indicates an incognito window
BrowserParam.description_zh: 浏览器启动参数，例如 `--incognito` 表示隐身窗口

CookiesSync.description_en: The cookie synchronization configuration. The string `true` indicates enabled. `false` indicates disabled
CookiesSync.description_zh: Cookie 同步配置。字符串 `true` 表示开启，`false` 表示关闭

Homepage.description_en: The homepage URL that opens when the browser starts
Homepage.description_zh: 浏览器启动时打开的首页地址

BrowserInstanceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the cloud browser group

BrowserInstanceGroupName.description_en: The name of the cloud browser group

BrowserInstanceGroupSetId.description_en: The ID of the browser group set to which the browser group belongs
BrowserInstanceGroupSetId.description_zh: 所属浏览器组集合的标识
BrowserInstanceGroupSetId.title_en: 浏览器交付组集合 ID。
BrowserInstanceGroupSetId.title_zh: 浏览器交付组集合 ID。

ChargeType.description_en: The billing type. In MAU scenarios, `PostPaid` is returned, which indicates pay-as-you-go
ChargeType.description_zh: 付费类型。MAU 场景返回 `PostPaid`，表示后付费

DefaultAccessUrl.description_en: The default access URL of the browser group. Use the URL returned by the API for access. The resource identifiers in the example must be replaced
DefaultAccessUrl.description_zh: 浏览器组的默认访问地址。请使用接口实际返回的地址访问；示例中的资源标识需要替换

Duration.description_en: The plan duration information. In MAU scenarios, plan duration does not apply, and an empty object may be returned
Duration.description_zh: 套餐时长信息。MAU 场景不涉及套餐时长，可返回空对象

CurrentPayStage.description_en: The current payment stage of the plan. Not applicable in MAU scenarios
CurrentPayStage.description_zh: 套餐当前支付阶段。MAU 场景不涉及

PeriodEndTime.description_en: The end time of the plan period. Not applicable in MAU scenarios. This field is not returned
PeriodEndTime.description_zh: 套餐周期结束时间。MAU 场景不涉及，不返回该字段

PeriodStartTime.description_en: The start time of the plan period. Not applicable in MAU scenarios. This field is not returned
PeriodStartTime.description_zh: 套餐周期开始时间。MAU 场景不涉及，不返回该字段

TotalDuration.description_en: The total duration of the plan, in seconds. Not applicable in MAU scenarios
TotalDuration.description_zh: 套餐总时长，单位为秒。MAU 场景不涉及

UsedDuration.description_en: The used duration of the plan, in seconds. Not applicable in MAU scenarios
UsedDuration.description_zh: 套餐已使用时长，单位为秒。MAU 场景不涉及

ExpiredTime.description_en: The expiration time of the browser group. Not applicable in MAU scenarios. This field is not returned
ExpiredTime.description_zh: 浏览器组过期时间。MAU 场景不涉及，不返回该字段

GmtCreate.description_en:
The creation time of the browser group.

The time is in RFC 3339 format: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSXXX`, which includes milliseconds and a time zone offset. The actual POP response uses the UTC offset `+00:00`
GmtCreate.description_zh:
浏览器组创建时间。

使用 RFC 3339 格式，具体为 `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSXXX`，包含毫秒和时区偏移；实际 POP 返回使用 UTC 偏移 `+00:00`

Homepage.description_en: The homepage URL of the browser group

ImageId.description_en: The image ID used by the browser group
ImageId.description_zh: 浏览器组使用的镜像标识

InstanceType.description_en: The instance type used by the browser group
InstanceType.description_zh: 浏览器组使用的实例规格

Network.description_en: The workspace network and website access restriction configuration
Network.description_zh: 办公网络及网站访问限制配置

AccessRestriction.description_en:
The website access restriction mode.

`ALLOW_ALL`: All domain names are allowed.
`ALLOW_LIST`: Only websites in the allowlist are allowed.

The returned value reflects the current configuration of the browser group
AccessRestriction.description_zh:
网站访问限制模式。

`ALLOW_ALL`：允许所有域名。
`ALLOW_LIST`：仅允许名单内的网站。

返回值反映该浏览器组现有配置

OfficeSiteId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the browser group belongs
OfficeSiteId.description_zh: 浏览器组所属的办公网络标识

VSwitchIds.description_en: The list of vSwitch IDs used by the browser group, available for scenarios with custom network configurations
VSwitchIds.description_zh: 浏览器组使用的交换机标识列表，供已配置定制网络的场景查看

OsType.description_en: The operating system type of the browser group. The current MAU product scenario uses Windows
OsType.description_zh: 浏览器组的操作系统类型。当前 MAU 产品场景使用 Windows

Policy.description_en: The policy configuration returned for the browser group. Policy fields are used to view existing settings and do not indicate that all corresponding creation parameters are configurable
Policy.description_zh: 浏览器组返回的策略配置。策略字段用于查看现有设置，不代表对应创建参数均可配置

AppContentProtection.description_en:
The screenshot protection switch.

`on`: Screenshot protection is enabled.
`off`: Screenshot protection is disabled
AppContentProtection.description_zh:
防截屏开关。

`on`：开启防截屏。
`off`：关闭防截屏

AuthorizeAccessPolicyRules.description_en: The client access IP address whitelist rules
AuthorizeAccessPolicyRules.description_zh: 客户端访问 IP 白名单规则

items.description_en: A configuration entry in the list

CidrIp.description_en: The source CIDR block of the client that is allowed to access
CidrIp.description_zh: 允许访问的客户端来源网段

Description.description_en: The description of the client access rule
Description.description_zh: 客户端访问规则的说明

Policy.description_en:
The action of the client access rule.

`allow`: Access is allowed.
`deny`: Access is denied
Policy.description_zh:
客户端访问规则的动作。

`allow`：允许访问。
`deny`：拒绝访问

ClientTypes.description_en: The client access control configuration list
ClientTypes.description_zh: 客户端访问控制配置列表

items.description_en: A configuration entry in the list

ClientType.description_en:
The client type.

`windows`: Windows client.
`macos`: macOS client.
`html5`: Web client.
`linux`: Linux client.
`android`: Android client.
`ios`: iOS client.

This field reflects the existing access configuration and does not indicate that all client types are available for the current product
ClientType.description_zh:
客户端类型。

`windows`：Windows 客户端。
`macos`：macOS 客户端。
`html5`：Web 客户端。
`linux`：Linux 客户端。
`android`：Android 客户端。
`ios`：iOS 客户端。

本字段反映已有访问配置，不代表当前产品开放所有客户端

Status.description_en:
The access policy switch for this client type.

`on`: Access from this client type is allowed.
`off`: Access from this client type is denied
Status.description_zh:
该客户端类型的访问策略开关。

`on`：允许该类客户端访问。
`off`：禁止该类客户端访问

ClipboardPolicy.description_en: The clipboard transfer direction, content type, and size limit settings. read indicates transfer from the local PC to the cloud browser. write indicates transfer from the cloud browser to the local PC
ClipboardPolicy.description_zh: 设置剪贴板传输方向、内容类型和大小限制。read 表示本地 PC 到云浏览器，write 表示云浏览器到本地 PC

Clipboard.description_en:
The clipboard transfer direction. The value is case-insensitive.

`off`: Bidirectional transfer is disabled.
`read`: Copy and paste from the local PC to the cloud browser is allowed.
`write`: Copy and paste from the cloud browser to the local PC is allowed.
`readwrite`: Bidirectional transfer is allowed
Clipboard.description_zh:
剪贴板传输方向，取值不区分大小写。

`off`：双向禁止。
`read`：允许本地 PC 向云浏览器复制粘贴。
`write`：允许云浏览器向本地 PC 复制粘贴。
`readwrite`：双向允许

VideoPolicy.description_en: The video display policy for browser sessions
VideoPolicy.description_zh: 浏览器会话的视频显示策略

FrameRate.description_en: The frame rate of browser sessions
FrameRate.description_zh: 浏览器会话的画面帧率

WatermarkPolicy.description_en: The watermark display configuration for browser sessions
WatermarkPolicy.description_zh: 浏览器会话的水印显示配置

WatermarkSwitch.description_en:
The watermark switch. The value is case-insensitive. Valid values:

`ON`: Watermark is enabled.
`OFF`: Watermark is disabled.

When disabled, the watermark content type list is not used
WatermarkSwitch.description_zh:
水印开关，取值不区分大小写。

`ON`：开启水印。
`OFF`：关闭水印。

关闭时不使用水印内容类型列表

WatermarkTypes.description_en:
The list of watermark content types. Valid values:

`EndUserId`: The user identifier.
`InstanceGroupId`: The delivery group identifier.
`ClientTime`: The current time on the client.

Use watermark types that are supported by the browser and client
WatermarkTypes.description_zh:
水印内容类型列表。

`EndUserId`：用户标识。
`InstanceGroupId`：交付组标识。
`ClientTime`：客户端当前时间。

请使用浏览器及客户端支持的水印类型

items.description_en: The watermark content type. EndUserId indicates the user identifier, InstanceGroupId indicates the delivery group identifier, and ClientTime indicates the current time on the client
items.description_zh: 水印内容类型。EndUserId 表示用户标识，InstanceGroupId 表示交付组标识，ClientTime 表示客户端当前时间

Status.description_en:
The browser group status.

`DEPLOYING`: Being deployed.
`PUBLISHED`: Deployed.
`FAILED`: Deployment failed.
`EXPIRED`: Expired.
`CEASED`: Suspended due to overdue payment.
`MAINTAINING`: Being updated.
`MAINTAIN_FAILED`: Update failed.
`DELETING`: Being deleted.
`UNAVAILABLE`: Unavailable
Status.description_zh:
浏览器组状态。

`DEPLOYING`：发布中。
`PUBLISHED`：发布成功。
`FAILED`：发布失败。
`EXPIRED`：已过期。
`CEASED`：欠费停服。
`MAINTAINING`：更新中。
`MAINTAIN_FAILED`：更新失败。
`DELETING`：删除中。
`UNAVAILABLE`：不可用

SubPayType.description_en: The sub-payment type. In MAU scenarios, the actual returned value is `mau`, which indicates billing by monthly active users
SubPayType.description_zh: 付费子类型。MAU 场景实际返回 `mau`，表示按月活跃用户计费

SupportUserGroupMixedAuth.description_en: Indicates whether mixed authorization of users and user groups is supported. `true` indicates supported, and `false` indicates not supported. Evaluate this value based on the current authorization mode
SupportUserGroupMixedAuth.description_zh: 是否支持用户和用户组混合授权。`true` 表示支持，`false` 表示不支持；应结合当前授权模式判断
SupportUserGroupMixedAuth.title_en: 是否支持用户和用户组混合授权。
SupportUserGroupMixedAuth.title_zh: 是否支持用户和用户组混合授权。

Tier.description_en:
The version of the browser. Valid values:

`Basic`: Basic Edition.
`Pro`: Premium Edition.

In MAU scenarios, the value is `Pro`
Tier.description_zh:
浏览器版本。

`Basic`：基础版。
`Pro`：高级版。

MAU 场景为 `Pro`

Timers.description_en: The session timer configurations currently returned. This is used to view the effective settings and does not indicate that the create operation supports setting this parameter
Timers.description_zh: 当前返回的会话定时配置，用于查看生效设置，不表示创建接口支持设置该参数

items.description_en: A configuration entry in the list

Interval.description_en: The session retention duration after disconnection, in minutes. `-1` indicates that the session is not unbound due to this timeout. The session is still subject to authorization and other session release policies
Interval.description_zh: 断开连接后的会话保留时长，单位为分钟。`-1` 表示不因该时长超时解绑，仍受授权和其他会话释放策略影响

TimerType.description_en: The timer configuration type. `SESSION_TIMEOUT` indicates the session retention duration after disconnection
TimerType.description_zh: 定时配置类型。`SESSION_TIMEOUT` 表示断开连接后的会话保留时长

UserGroupAuthMode.description_en:
The current authorization mode. Valid values:

`Mixed`: Mixed authorization of users and user groups.
`User`: User authorization.
`UserGroup`: User group authorization
UserGroupAuthMode.description_zh:
当前授权模式。

`Mixed`：用户和用户组混合授权。
`User`：用户授权。
`UserGroup`：用户组授权
UserGroupAuthMode.title_en: 用户和用户组授权模式。
UserGroupAuthMode.title_zh: 用户和用户组授权模式。

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的标识，用于排查问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of browser groups that match the filter conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合筛选条件的浏览器组总数
